notes.title: FANCY!
notes.content:
https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/39781881/5f20e093425bdca9123c8a0635565727a4f5f33d.png

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2173730/FANCY/

Gameplay:

FANCY! is an exciting puzzle game with delicious, sweet candy combinations! You will find many bright and varied visuals and very beautiful music. In this game you need to correctly match the same candies in a row so that they disappear (no matter in which direction), collect points, and open new levels. After each completed level, you will discover new pictures ! Collect the required number of points and conquer one level after another!


With "FANCY!" You will be able to breathe from difficult games, you will immerse yourself in the world of various, colorful candies and nice music. Here you will find an amazing variety of new levels, a beautiful gallery, animation and pleasant music! Collecting colorful candies will become more and more interesting with each new level! Enjoy an interesting game! Many interesting levels with stunning graphics are waiting for you!


What you can find in this game:



 Challenging and interesting levels at the same time.
 Incredible graphics and animation.
 Incredible sound and visual effects.
 Funny levels.
 Relax and have a great time.
 100 Achivments.
 Enjoy your day with cute girls.

notes.title: New Game - Project: Mirror
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2171840/Project_Mirror/

Project: MIRROR! 
is a world full of magic, there souls of beautiful girls have broken into several pieces during a violent and powerful storm. You are the only one who can help the beauties revive their souls!

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/39781881/5b7efab60a2633d5d2ddccdbd0c64d7d88fd4abc.png

Tired after a hard day at work? Then Project: MIRROR! is all you need. In a world full of magic and fantastic creatures, the souls of beautiful girls have broken into several pieces during a violent and powerful storm. You, as one of the survivors of this catastrophe, are the only one who can help the beauties revive their souls.


GAMEPLAY:
Project: MIRROR! is a casual game where you can choose between two worlds where you want to play. The worlds have their own levels and differ in design and gameplay.

In the first world, you have to drag one point to another and form a shape out of all the lines.
The second world has a simple Match-Three type of game where you have to create one line of three or more elements to earn points.

Each world contains many different and interesting levels. You get stars for completing a level. Images will be unlocked after several levels you complete. These images can always be viewed and downloaded in the gallery. The game has a hundred achievements. There is also a button for skipping levels.


GAME FEATURES:


 Choose between two different worlds
 Pass levels and gain stars
 Unlock and collect images
 Take 100 achievements
 Relax with music while playing
 Can skip any level with one-click
 Download images from gallery
 Enjoy your day with a cute girls!
